entries.a10090c7da42dd8b: This business manufactures and sells concrete piles, purchases and sells building materials, and undertakes contracts for various construction works incidental to concrete secondary products. Consolidated subsidiary TA Pile Seizō Co., Ltd. handles product shipment and on-site work, and Tōshō Co., Ltd. handles the purchase of raw materials such as cement materials and joint fittings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥11,492 million, the largest of the two businesses. Kakufuji Co., Ltd. is printed as a major customer.
